description: This file implements the ResourceManager plugin for a media or device management system, providing methods for controlling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and interacting with external components via JSON-RPC. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and external API interactions.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: A helper class for making JSON-RPC calls to other components, supporting synchronous invoke, get, and set operations.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets the AV blocked status for a given application ID.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of applications currently blocked for AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS (Text-to-Speech) resources for a specific client application.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for multiple applications.
